{{Quote|You want to know why I left behind the flash and the credits, Ta? It's because you're boring.|Kaliyo Djannis|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
'''Ta Tigal''' was a [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabrak]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Gambling/Legends|gambler]] who lived during the time of the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|resurgent Sith Empire]]. He was a former lover of [[Kaliyo Djannis]] and remained in love with her, even though she swindled him in the past. He wanted to reignite their relationship and sought her out again but his search for her drew her ire as it was drawing unwanted attention onto her. Kaliyo managed to persuade [[Imperial Intelligence (Sith Empire)|Imperial Intelligence]] to make him a target.

[[Cipher Nine]] and Kaliyo then tracked him down to [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]].
